fact: Law No. 23-016/AU of 27 July 2023 creates a national population register of biographic and biometric data for the Union of the Comoros, fed by the central civil register, with a biometric census study commissioned to define its technical criteria.
title: Consultation internationale en charge d'élaborer l'étude portant sur les modalités du recensement biométrique à vocation d'état civil aux Comores
